papers.title: IBIB: A Protocol for Measuring Enterprise AI Systems by Serving Route, Not Model Identifier
papers.abstract: Enterprises deploy systems, not checkpoints. Usable capability depends jointly on weights, serving route, precision, output contract, and harness, yet all 18 audited benchmarks score advertised model identifiers. We treat this as measurement error and give a protocol that makes it reportable. It has three parts. A gold-blind capability-binding preflight verifies that a route can execute the evaluation contract before any task reaches it; a reliability-inclusive first-pass scoring rule keeps fail
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.10494v1）：IBIB 把'企业部署的是系统、不是 checkpoint'做成可报告的测量问题——gold-blind capability-binding preflight + reliability-inclusive first-pass scoring + 18 个被审计基准的差距诊断。这正好命中 aiutil 长期关心的'评测 ≠ 模型标识符'：weights / serving route / precision / output contract / harness 应作为联合变量打分。与 aiutil 关心的 routing / eval-governance 路线高度共振。代码/benchmark：暂无（数据来自 18 份公开 benchmark 的审计结果），需打开 PDF 看协议定义是否可作为内部 eval template 复用。

papers.title: Show-Harness: Just a VLM Agent Can Play Robots
papers.abstract: Foundation vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit broad intelligence about the world, yet translating this intelligence into robot control remains challenging. We present Show-Harness, an Embodied Harness that enables VLMs to "play" robots through a compact semantic interface linking intent to action. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.10522v1）：Show-Harness 用 compact semantic interface 把 VLM 桥接到机器人控制——expose discrete semantic action units，embodiment-specific interpreters 确定性 ground 到 local action。属于 embodied agent / world-model 路线，趋势价值高于即时试验价值。代码/benchmark：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 sim2real 与 action unit 抽象是否给出工程复用点。

papers.title: IdeaAMBIG: Benchmarking Implementation-Critical Gaps in Research-Idea Specifications
papers.abstract: A research idea may be novel, coherent, and scientifically plausible, yet its proposed method may remain insufficiently specified for faithful implementation. We study the codification readiness of implementation-facing research-method specifications, defined by whether they provide sufficient methodological information for a competent implementer or coding agent to construct the intended method without unsupported assumptions. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.10539v1）：IdeaAMBIG 直接量化'research idea 描述到实现之间到底缺多少信息'——'codification readiness' 维度对'写作 agent + coding agent' 流水线是核心瓶颈。属于 LLM-eval × coding-agent 交叉方法学资产，与 aiutil 的'程序化知识'路线（2609.09153）共振。代码/benchmark：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 evaluation contract 与 evidence-grounded spec 的构造方法。

papers.title: A positive resolution of the gap-entropy conjecture
papers.abstract: We prove the gap-entropy conjecture for fixed-confidence best-arm identification with independent unit-variance Gaussian arms, means in $[0,1]$, and a unique optimal arm. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.10529v1）：证明固定置信 best-arm identification 的 gap-entropy 下界最优——BAI 理论的精确刻画。长尾保留：理论资产，与 aiutil 当前路线相关度有限（实验/RL 选 arm 时偶尔会引用）。代码/benchmark：暂无。

papers.title: Likelihood-free inference with nuisance parameters through normalizing flows
papers.abstract: We present a simple decomposition of a neural-network-based normalizing flow that naturally uncovers a pivotal statistic (or something close) in the presence of nuisance parameters, based only on a sample generator from the distribution of interest. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.10534v1）：用 normalizing flow 分解自然导出 nuisance-parameter 设置下的近 pivotal statistic，附带 KL-p-value 与 power 论证。理论推断资产——长尾保留。除非团队正做 likelihood-free inference / 仿真推断，否则相关性有限。代码/benchmark：暂无。

papers.title: Characterizing Language Generation in the Limit: Finite Witnesses and a Separation-Width Hierarch
papers.abstract: Language generation in the limit asks for valid unseen elements from every exhaustive positive presentation of an unknown infinite language. We characterize this task for arbitrary families over a countable universe. Generation is possible exactly when each target can be assigned a finite positive witness so that the targets activated by any finite sample have an infinite common intersection. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.10525v1）：'Language generation in the limit' 给出一个 finite-witness 充要条件 + separation-width 层级。属于形式语言/学习理论资产，长尾保留——对 in-context learning / distribution shift 的边界讨论有间接价值。代码/benchmark：暂无。

papers.title: Cross-Model Agreement as a Deployment-Time Reliability Signal for Automatic Polyp Segmentation
papers.abstract: In real-time colonoscopy, ground-truth annotations are unavailable at inference, so polyp segmentation models can fail silently. We propose Referee-Based Quality Estimation (RBQE), a reference-free framework measuring agreement between a primary segmentation model and an independently trained referee on the same image. RBQE is evaluated on a standardized 1,223-image external benchmark drawn from four public datasets, using four referee configurations chosen to separate two design axes: referee i
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.10495v1）：RBQE 用 cross-model agreement 作为部署时无 ground-truth 的可靠性信号——4 referee 配置、1223 外部 benchmark。方法学资产（'用 reference-free agreement 估计模型可靠性'）有迁移价值，但领域是医学影像分割。代码/benchmark：暂无，长尾保留其方法学价值。

papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.10514v1）：低秩量子态层析在有界样本联合测量下的最优样本复杂度下界/上界。量子信息理论，与 aiutil 关注方向偏离较大；新意/相关性较弱。代码/benchmark：暂无。

papers.title: Quantum Feature Engineering for Credit Default Prediction: When and Why IQP Circuits Help Linear Classifiers
papers.abstract: Credit default prediction is a tabular classification problem in which modest gains in F1 translate directly into reduced financial exposure. We ask whether Instantaneous Quantum Polynomial-time (IQP) circuits can produce features that improve a classifier over both its raw classical baseline and Kernel PCA - the strongest unsupervised classical non-linear alternative - at an equal feature budget. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.10505v1）：在 23 维信用违约数据上比较 IQP 电路特征 vs Kernel PCA 的线性分类器增益。量子机器学习在小规模金融表格数据上的应用——量子路线 + 金融领域同时偏离 aiutil 核心方向。代码/benchmark：暂无。
